# Sunbright Recovery Center

> Sunbright Recovery Center is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit, 16-bed, co-ed residential addiction recovery center at 22425 Sunbright Ave, Red Bluff, California 96080, serving Northern California and the rest of the state. Licensed by the State Department of Health Care Services.

<!-- STAGED FOR LAUNCH. Before copying over public/llms.txt: confirm every line with Linda,
     add the DHCS license link, and delete any service she has not confirmed. -->

Key facts:
- Level of care: residential treatment, 30, 60 and 90-day stays. [CONFIRM with Linda]
- Medical detox: not provided on site; Sunbright coordinates referral to a detox provider.
- Payment: private pay. Insurance credentialing in progress; no insurance plan is accepted yet.
- Nonprofit: IRS 501(c)(3) public charity, EIN 42-2737546.
- Founder: Linda Spyres, LCSW, LAADC-CA. Program Manager: Faith O'Dell, SUDRC.
- Phone: (530) 513-4294. Email: info@sunbrightrecovery.org.
- Faith integration is optional, never required.
